title: SentinelOne Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on SentinelOne Singularity. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into a PowerQuery with pySigma (SentinelOne EDR field mapping) or runs the native PowerQuery written for SentinelOne, looks up the indicators of indicator hunts in the EDR fields that hold them, executes the query as a Singularity Data Lake Long Running Query over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the SentinelOne Singularity Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Raw events never leave SentinelOne: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample. Quotas: a query expires 30 seconds after its launch or its last poll, query launches are throttled (HTTP 429, retried with backoff), and SentinelOne does not document the concurrent query budget of an account; the connector polls every second, reads at most 10,000 rows per query and holds at most 3 runs at a time (CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS). Before you start: a SentinelOne service user with a read-only role that can search events (e.g. Viewer) and its API token. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#sentinelone, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to PowerQuery, native PowerQuery or indicator lookups) on SentinelOne Singularity and reports hits, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
